subject: Obstruction - Northern Grand Banks
text:
Obstruction - Northern Grand Banks
An array of dynamic positioning transponder beacons have been deployed in support of Equinor's drilling campaign in the vicinity of: 47 50.578N 047 05.083W.
Beacons extend above the sea floor by 5 meters.
Vessels shall maintain a wide berth of at least 500 meters from above listed position. 
Any fish harvesters who believe they have had gear damage as a result of operations are advised to contact Strat Canning at 462-3692 (office) or 330-0701 (cell),or email address: SCANNING@CANPITT.CA 
Caution
